card.name: Photo captions and slideshow text
card.fires_on: Small words and punctuation (of, comma, period, Here) right after a photo caption, image title or slide counter on news and gallery pages. It marks the spot where the caption text is ending or turning into body text.

modes.label: Caption titles and credits
modes.description: The word 'of' or a comma inside a photo title or image credit line, such as a place name caption.
modes.example: City Lights<< of>> Dubai, United Arab Emirates – Originally Published

modes.label: Slide counters and photo intros
modes.description: The word 'of' in a slide counter, or the lead-in word after a news photo caption.

card.writes: It promotes caption-style tokens such as Chinese 'picture shows' and 'photo credit', so it adds an image-caption feel.
card.plain: It notices when text is a photo caption or slideshow label rather than normal prose.
